evals.prompt: Write the image prompts for my character sheets and the keyframes of scene 1. I use a tool that accepts up to 3 reference images.
evals.expected_output: A generation plan in dependency order, image_prompt records with locks verbatim, references with roles (max 3), must_match lists.
expectations: A generation plan orders character sheets before keyframes
Each prompt record has references with an explicit role and never more than 3 references
Identity locks from the character file appear verbatim in the prompts
Each record has a must_match checklist

evals.prompt: This keyframe is perfect except her bag is on the wrong hip. Fix it.
evals.expected_output: A single edit prompt that changes only the bag side and explicitly keeps face, outfit, pose, light and composition.
expectations: The edit prompt changes only the bag position
The prompt explicitly states what must stay unchanged
The bag side is stated unambiguously

evals.prompt: Make the prompt more epic: add dramatic lightning and a second character in the background.
evals.expected_output: Declines to add content not in the shot record, explains ownership, offers to route a proposal.
expectations: No lightning or extra character is added to the prompt
The response explains that prompt content comes from approved records
A route to the owning department is offered
